title: Four-panel adult ecchi yonkoma comic
brief: Create a finished Japanese-style adult ecchi gag yonkoma (4-panel) comic in a tall 1:4 format, cute anime illustration style with clean lineart and soft cel shading, tasteful nudity. The heroine is Akane, a mature adult woman in her late twenties with a voluptuous curvy figure and large breasts, long pink hair, pink eyes with heart-shaped pupils; keep her design identical in all four panels. Classic structure: setup, development, twist, punchline.
